name: Metric TSP four-thirds conjecture
question: Is optimum metric TSP cost at most 4/3 times the Held–Karp subtour LP?
method_title: A new metric class, both optima certified
dispatch_next: Extend from graphic metrics to 1-2 and vertex-weighted metrics, and enumerate extreme points of the subtour polytope at n = 8 to search for gap-maximising instances.
dispatch_why: Graphic metrics through 7 vertices are a certified reproduction. The next experiment changes the metric class rather than adding vertices inside the published small-n range.

campaign.method: Exact rational LP with duality certificates over graphic metrics
campaign.hypothesis: For every metric TSP instance the optimal tour costs at most 4/3 of the Held-Karp (subtour LP) bound.
campaign.first_proof_obligation: Reproduce published exact maximum integrality gaps for all small metrics (Benoit-Boyd) with LP-duality certificates, then target a structured class such as graphic metrics of subcubic graphs beyond published ranges.
campaign.next_experiment: Extend from graphic metrics to 1-2 and vertex-weighted metrics, and enumerate extreme points of the subtour polytope at n = 8 to search for gap-maximising instances.
campaign.falsification: A metric instance with an exactly certified Held-Karp value and a brute-force optimal tour longer than 4/3 of it.
campaign.blocker: Exhaustive extreme-point enumeration grows very quickly beyond n = 10; graphic metrics up to 7 vertices reach only a 16/15 gap.

probes.name: Metric TSP four-thirds conjecture
probes.title: Held-Karp integrality gap on all graphic metrics up to N vertices
probes.frontier: Known: the integrality gap is at least 4/3 and at most 3/2 (Wolsey; Shmoys-Williamson); exact maximum gaps have been computed for all metrics on small n (Benoit-Boyd 2008).

smoke.scope: For the shortest-path metric of every connected graph on 3..6 vertices, OPT <= (4/3) * HK with both values certified exactly.

deep.scope: For the shortest-path metric of every connected graph on 3..7 vertices, OPT <= (4/3) * HK with both values certified exactly.

milestones.title: Held-Karp integrality gap certified on all 141 graphic metrics with 3-6 vertices
milestones.description: Every instance carries an exact LP-duality certificate checked against all subtour constraints and a brute-force optimal tour; the maximum ratio is 1 for n <= 6. The deep run covers 994 instances up to n = 7, with maximum gap 16/15.
